title: Stage 3 Sequence Evaluation Runtime Atlas
subtitle: Whole-sequence evaluation route for FrontRES Segment Replay. Block IDs match source comments; evidence is code-confirmed plus fake-runner contract unless noted otherwise.

nodes.title: CLI exposes sequence eval mode
nodes.role: Adds the sequence-eval flag, unique-sequence count, rollout length, and smoke-test preroll cap to the Stage 3 command surface.
nodes.input: Stage 3 launch command with mode=sequence_eval, OFFLINE_EVAL_SEQUENCES, OFFLINE_EVAL_STEPS, and OFFLINE_EVAL_MAX_PREROLL_STEPS.
nodes.output: Parsed CLI flags for sequence offline evaluation.
nodes.forbidden: Must not enter training or segment-local offline_eval when sequence_eval is requested.

children.title: Dispatch eval and exit
children.role: Calls runner.run_frontres_segment_sequence_offline_eval and closes env after evaluation.
children.input: Parsed CLI sequence_eval flag, num_eval_sequences, rollout_steps.
children.output: Evaluation runs once and returns before normal training.
children.forbidden: Must not fall through into runner.learn().

children.title: Thin runner API
children.role: Keeps OnPolicyRunner as a delegating API boundary.
children.forbidden: Runner method must not own sequence sampling, reset, or metrics logic.

nodes.title: Build unique sequence plan
nodes.role: Selects unique motion ids, optionally filters smoke-test samples by max_preroll_steps, and defines reset_frame=0, preroll_steps=start_frame, and eval window.
nodes.input: Candidate segment specs from the live Segment Replay sampler.
nodes.output: FrontRESSegmentSequenceEvalPlan with one item per unique motion sequence.
nodes.forbidden: Must not treat env count as sequence count, start evaluation at segment frame directly, or silently run deep prerolls during smoke tests.

children.title: Repeat segment over B1 layout
children.role: Fills the full env batch with one segment id so repaired/noisy/clean roles compare the same motion.
children.input: One sequence eval item and env_count.
children.forbidden: Must not mix different motions inside one B1 comparison group.

children.title: Build frame0 reset batch
children.role: Rewrites sampled segment specs to start_frame=0 for reset while preserving original eval item boundaries.
children.input: Eval batch plus sequence eval item.
children.output: Reset batch whose specs start from motion frame 0.
children.forbidden: Must not mutate the original eval batch start_frame.

nodes.title: Collect candidate specs
nodes.role: Samples index-only batches until enough unique motion specs survive the requested sequence count and optional preroll cap.
nodes.input: FrontRES segment sampler and requested sequence count.
nodes.output: Candidate spec list passed into the sequence plan builder.
nodes.forbidden: Must not run rollout while only discovering sequence candidates.

children.title: Evaluate one sequence per pass
children.role: Loops over plan.items so each motion sequence gets its own reset/preroll/eval lifecycle.
children.forbidden: Must not batch unrelated sequences with different preroll lengths into one metric window.
children.diagnostic: runtime-confirmed: frontres_segment_sequence_eval_contract.py emits two reset and four rollout events for two sequences.

children.title: Reset, no-capture preroll, capture eval
children.role: Prints per-sequence progress including preroll length, silences verbose reset trace, advances preroll without motion-quality frames, then captures the eval window.
children.input: Reset batch, live observations, preroll_steps, eval_rollout_steps.
children.output: FrontRESSegmentLiveRolloutCapture for the scoring window only.
children.forbidden: Must not store motion-quality frames during preroll or spam perturbation reset traces during evaluation.

children.title: Apply index-only reset
children.role: Applies the current reset batch to the live environment and records reset request/result.
children.forbidden: Must not skip env reset when a current sequence reset batch is present.

children.title: Run live rollout capture
children.role: Steps the live env and captures transition/reward/done; motion-quality frames are optional.
children.diagnostic: runtime-confirmed: contract test distinguishes preroll_no_capture=True from eval_capture=True.

nodes.title: Attach sequence metadata
nodes.role: Adds motion id, reset frame, preroll steps, and eval start frame to each sequence summary.
nodes.output: Per-sequence summary with explicit temporal boundaries.
nodes.forbidden: Must not report segment metrics without the motion-sequence boundary that produced them.

children.title: Merge sequence summaries
children.role: Averages numeric metrics and preserves per-motion rows/motion ids.
children.input: List of per-sequence summaries and plan.
children.forbidden: Must not drop per-motion rows that help review weak sequences.

children.title: Print compact result log
children.role: Emits per-sequence progress/result lines plus final and per-motion success/fall/survival, score gain, MPJPE, velocity error, acceleration error, action norm, and motion ids.
children.forbidden: Must not hide long-running sequence progress, final motion ids, or motion-quality metrics from the training log.

nodes.title: Live GPU coverage not captured locally
nodes.role: Marks the remaining evidence gap for whole-run runtime coverage.
nodes.input: Local fake-runner contract, codegraph static path, and py_compile.
nodes.output: Current atlas is code-confirmed and contract-runtime-confirmed, not coverage-confirmed against a real GPU launch.
nodes.forbidden: Must not claim exhaustive live coverage until a real sequence_eval launch is traced by coverage/trace/log evidence.
nodes.diagnostic: expected next evidence: real sequence_eval log or coverage.py/trace artifact from the GPU run.
